annotation.summary_en: Search-result page on China's national standards platform listing one recommended national standard, GB/T 46958-2025, a scenario-based safety evaluation framework for testing automated driving systems in road vehicles. Published 31 Dec 2025, effective 1 April 2026, status current, adopted from an international standard. Only metadata is shown.
key_provisions_or_claims: GB/T 46958-2025 is a recommended (voluntary) national standard for road vehicles.
Establishes a scenario-based safety assessment framework for automated driving system test scenarios.
Marked as adopting an international standard (采标).
